comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
The requirements to join Royal Navy were relaxed to 5th Knight a while back. Also, these recipes only appear when you've accumulated a certain Royal Navy points threshhold. They are:

Sailor clothes: 2,000 points
Shoes: 5,000 points
Hats: 7,5000 points
Gloves: 9,000 points
Dress Sword: 10,000 points
Baudelaire: 12,000 points
Jedburgh Staff: 13,000 points
Jr. Officer clothes: 20,000 points
Field Officer clothes: 34,000 points
Naval Commander clothes: 48,000 points

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Recipe/Special
